html:
Austria is a small, mostly Alpine country in central Europe, with Vienna as its capital. The modern republic was what remained of the Habsburg monarchy after the First World War: in 1918 the German speaking core was left alone, cut off from the lands it had ruled.

It appears on the map in 1920 and 1930, then disappears. In 1938 Hitler, himself Austrian born, annexed it to Germany in the Anschluss. After 1945 the four Allied powers occupied it until the Austrian State Treaty of 1955, which restored independence on condition of permanent neutrality.

Austria then grew into a prosperous neutral state between East and West, and joined the European Union in 1995. Its older history, as the seat of the Habsburgs and of the Holy Roman Empire, is under the Austrian Empire.
